title: Windows: clipboard sync, background run, system theme & full icon pass
highlights: Windows: clipboard now syncs both directions — copy text on the Mac and paste on Windows (and the reverse). Echo-suppression prevents loops.
Windows: closing the window keeps Entanglo running in the background so input sharing, clipboard and discovery stay alive. Use the new Quit button in Settings for a real exit.
Windows: live RTT — the Dashboard latency metric now updates the moment each heartbeat round-trip lands, not on a polling interval.

Windows: complete icon pass on Dashboard, Devices, Network, Updates, Logs, Input Sharing and Settings — status, counts, RTT and actions are now Segoe MDL2 glyphs instead of words like 'Connected', 'Linked' or 'RTT'.
Windows: theme-aware chrome — Mica BaseAlt with Acrylic fallback, page backgrounds transparent so the system's light/dark choice shows through.
